basis: Independent sanity check of fixed already-inspected historical populations; not model selection or predictive validation

priorities.work: Define decimal or exact tick midpoint comparisons, retain flats explicitly and verify bid/ask and pair pip semantics in a separately versioned scorer.
priorities.acceptance: Reproduce original stored counts and corrected exact counts separately; test spread-only changes, symmetric midpoint changes, tiny legitimate moves and exotic pip sizes; no historical forecast mutation.

priorities.work: Use aligned log or economically normalized returns, consistent base/quote orientation and a leave-target-pair-out common currency factor. Compare own-price lags against added peer lags on identical future decisions.
priorities.acceptance: Freeze pairs, lookbacks, regularization and training/label availability rules before a fresh sample; preserve all abstentions and missing data, and require incremental after-cost improvement.

priorities.work: Implement compact multivariate baselines and train-only cointegration diagnostics; separate short-run lead-lag from long-run basket equilibrium.
priorities.acceptance: Require stable train-only relationships, time-respecting evaluation, independent episodes and improvement against the fixed own-price and no-trade baselines; no full-window fitted relation credited as historically available.

priorities.work: Estimate common factors and changing regimes on prior observations; test whether residual relative strength adds forecast information.
priorities.acceptance: Distinguish state reconstruction from prediction; freeze the model and validate transitions and uncertainty on untouched outcomes.

priorities.work: Measure matched prediction and error covariance and consider prior-label-only calibration or stacking after individual baselines are established.
priorities.acceptance: Beat equal probability averaging, fixed members and no-trade after costs on identical future decisions; do not count correlated votes as independent confirmation.

known_limits: Strong same-time currency correlation and PCA variance share do not establish leading predictive information.
The archived consensus slices and 35 lead-lag cells were already inspected and cannot become untouched confirmation.
Existing historical lead-lag and modern model reports did not establish positive eligible performance.
A new numerical model or feature contract requires a separate registration; this plan activates nothing.
